webAutomation.promptTemplate: 请使用我上传的 skill pack 和源码文件完成代码审查。只评审源码文件，不要把 skill pack 当作待评审对象。请按 skill pack 里的输出契约直接返回 Review Result、Markdown Report、English HTML Report 和 Chinese HTML Report。默认只显示 Major 及以上的 finding，Minor 和 Info 不要出现在最终报告中。

compactRuleReferences.title: Only code-proven functional issues stay high severity
compactRuleReferences.guidance: Keep major or critical only when the reviewed code directly proves correctness, runtime, memory, concurrency, security, or externally visible impact.

compactRuleReferences.title: Collapse same-root-cause findings
compactRuleReferences.guidance: If multiple observations describe the same integer conversion, boundary, or logic defect, keep only the single most specific actionable finding.

compactRuleReferences.title: Suppress speculative findings
compactRuleReferences.guidance: Do not keep null-pointer, caller-contract, wraparound, portability, or defensive-programming findings unless the failing path is directly visible in the reviewed code.

compactRuleReferences.title: Runtime-error-prone arithmetic and conversion constructs
compactRuleReferences.guidance: Use this rule only when the code directly demonstrates arithmetic or conversion behavior that can change program results.
